caption: Bacon strips laid in a hot pan begin to sizzle, and the strips shrink and curl at the edges.

sa.check: Bacon strips lie in a hot pan.
The strips are flat and straight at the start.
The shrinking and curling come after the strips are in the pan.

pc.expect: The strips go from limp flat slices to stiffer buckled ones that hold their curl, and the fat that leaves them is a thin liquid.
pc.fail: A strip stays perfectly flat and limp while shrunken and glossy; or a strip melts away entirely into the fat; or the fat stands as a dome beside the strips; or a strip stretches longer as it cooks.

pc.expect: The shrinking and curling only advance and the strips do not flatten out or grow again.
pc.fail: A curled strip flattens out and lengthens again in the hot pan; or the strips shrink and grow in turn; or a strip's curl eases while the pan stays hot; or the fat draws back into the strips.

pc.expect: Each strip stays one strip that buckles and ripples along its length, keeping its two ends.
pc.fail: A strip splits into separate pieces with nothing cutting it; or the strips fuse into one sheet; or a strip rolls into a solid tube with no seam; or a strip turns into another object.

pc.expect: The fat runs to the pan's low places and pools there, and the strips stay in the pan.
pc.fail: The fat climbs the pan's wall and stays; or a strip lifts off the pan and hangs; or the fat gathers on top of a strip and stays; or the fat runs uphill.

pc.expect: The strips keep their number in the pan and none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A strip vanishes; or a new strip appears in the pan; or two strips merge into one; or a strip passes through the pan's floor.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The bacon browning as it cooks is chemistry and is not judged.
